verdict.rationale: Belvo is an open-finance API platform, so an official CLI is a fair question for this kind of product and the axis applies. The evidence pack shows no CLI, only a Postman collection, MCP servers for Cursor and VS Code, an llms.txt file and a 'Copy for LLM' feature. These are adjacent developer tools and do not count as an official CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
